name: top.kuanmi.unityrhi
description: NVRHI-shaped D3D12 render hardware interface for Unity. Records command streams that replay directly onto Unity's own D3D12 command list, exposing ray tracing, bindless resources, compute and explicit barriers that the engine does not surface. Supports the Built-in Render Pipeline across Unity 2021.3 to Unity 6. Requires Direct3D12 to be the active graphics API.
